# Rule reference

43 rules in 6 categories. 37 can be created automatically, all of them safe for `psx watch --fix`.

Severity is the default; override it per project in `psx.yml`:

```yaml
rules:
  readme: error
  license: false   # disabled
```

Run `psx explain <rule>` for one rule in full, or `psx rules` for this list.

## CI/CD (8)

| Rule | Severity | Fix | Creates | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ci_config` | info | manual | — | Run tests automatically on every change |
| `dependency_updates` | warning | auto (safe) | `.github/dependabot.yml` | Keep dependencies patched automatically |
| `release_workflow` | info | manual | — | Automate releases from tags |
| `workflow_ci` | info | auto (safe) | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Validate every push and pull request |
| `workflow_codeql` | warning | auto (safe) | `.github/workflows/codeql.yml` | Scan for vulnerabilities with CodeQL |
| `workflow_docker` | info | auto (safe) | `.github/workflows/docker.yml` | Build container images and cache the layers |
| `workflow_release` | info | auto (safe) | `.github/workflows/release.yml` | Publish artifacts from a version tag |
| `workflow_secret_scan` | warning | auto (safe) | `.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml` | Detect leaked credentials before they are merged |
